notes.title: New In-Car View, EXP System, and Leaderboards in Fastest Cars Traffic Racer
notes.notes:
🚗 In-Car Camera with Driver Character
Get ready for an immersive driving experience with our brand-new in-car camera view, featuring a driver character! Now, you can enjoy racing from inside the vehicle, bringing a new level of realism and excitement to every race.

🚘 New Car Added
A sleek new car has joined the roster! Test its performance and make it your new favorite as you tackle traffic and aim for high scores.

📈 EXP System and Improved Main Menu Design
Level up as you score! Our updated main menu now includes an EXP system, allowing players to progress and reach new levels based on their achievements. Menu designs have also been revamped for a more intuitive and engaging experience.

🏆 Steam Leaderboards
Compete with racers worldwide! The new leaderboard system lets you view the top 10 players with the highest scores and check your rank among other drivers. See how you stack up against the competition and aim for the top spot!

Get ready to take Fastest Cars Traffic Racer to the next level with this exciting update. Don’t miss out on the new features, jump in and start racing!
